package.name: arc_logging
package.description: Records a run's topics to MCAP (rosbag2's MCAP storage), every topic but camera images unless the run asks for them (ADR-0056), in chunks, started and stopped with the platform, in its own process so an experiment can't stop it and it can't block the platform; reports on /diagnostics when a run isn't being logged (SYS-09, SYS-21, SYS-24, #152).
